sourceNotes.note: Antonio Williams led WAS in routes (88%), targets (24%), catches in first full game without McLaurin (IR).
Falcons Ebukam and Branch (hamstrings) out this week; Bengals Turner day-to-day, Howell likely IR.
Canales: could potentially open practice windows for Jonathon Brooks and Xavier Legette this week; still recovery items to clear. Other Panthers updates (Phillips day-to-day, etc.).
Reported Brooks abdomen recovery and potential practice window open via Person.

items.text: First full game without Terry McLaurin (IR, knee) last night. Round 3 rookie Antonio Williams led the team in routes (88%), targets (24%), and catches.
items.why: Led team in routes, targets, and catches in first full game without McLaurin.
items.implication: Williams emerging as primary option in WAS offense with McLaurin out for season; high route and target share.
items.opportunity: Strong waiver add for WR depth; potential weekly flex with volume.

items.text: Injury updates: #Falcons coach Kevin Stefanski says Samson Ebukam and Zachariah Branch have hamstring injuries and are out this week.
items.why: Coach confirms hamstring injuries; out for Week 9.
items.implication: ATL WR depth thins; targets redistribute to other receivers (London, etc.); minor volume shift possible for Bijan Robinson in pass game.
items.opportunity: Monitor ATL WR2/3 for elevated targets; Bijan role stable.

items.text: Canales: Panthers could "potentially" open the 21-day windows for Jonathon Brooks and Xavier Legette this week. But said both have some things they still need to clear recovery-wise.
items.why: Coach indicates potential to open 21-day practice windows this week pending recovery clearance.
items.implication: Brooks (RB) could return to practice soon; monitor for activation and role behind current RBs.
items.opportunity: Speculative stash if available; possible late-season RB depth if healthy.
